name: Nuki Smart Lock Pro 5th Gen (EU)

radios.note: Nuki's generations table marks built-in Wi-Fi and Matter over Thread as yes for the Pro (5th Gen). When Remote Access via Thread is available, Nuki says Wi-Fi is switched off.

matter.note: CSA lists 'Nuki Smart Lock Pro' (hardware 10.00, firmware 1.4.1, certified 2025-11-18) with no generation label, separate from the 4th Gen Pro listings (hardware 7.x). Nuki's generations table marks Matter over Thread for the Pro (5th Gen).

apple_home.note: Matter over Thread. Nuki says you need a hub that supports Matter via Thread; a Wi-Fi-only Matter hub will not work.

google_home.note: Matter over Thread, which needs a Thread border router. Nuki also documents a Nuki Web cloud link to Google Home for its locks; not checked for this generation.

alexa.note: Matter over Thread, which needs a Thread border router. Nuki also documents a Nuki Web skill for Alexa; not checked for this generation.

smartthings.note: Nuki names Samsung SmartThings as a Matter-over-Thread platform; a Thread border router is needed.

home_assistant.note: Home Assistant's Nuki page seen covers 4th generation locks; no official source names the 5th-gen Pro. A forum thread reports Matter commissioning problems, which is not an official source.

hubRequired.note: Built-in Wi-Fi and Remote Access are included, so no Bridge is needed. Matter control needs a Thread border router.

localControl.note: No Nuki source describes offline or local-only control explicitly.

lockFit.note: Fits over the existing interior cylinder without a cylinder swap; Nuki says it suits Europrofile cylinders and selected Swiss Round cylinders. It is not compatible with Nuki's Universal Cylinder.

keypad.note: No keypad on the lock. Nuki's Keypad 2 NFC is a separate accessory.

power.note: Built-in lithium-ion battery that recharges in about 2 hours, on or off the door.

summary: This retrofit lock, the 5th-generation Nuki Pro, is built for Europrofile cylinders and needs no cylinder change. Matter over Thread links it to Apple Home, Google Home, Alexa and SmartThings, and built-in Wi-Fi covers remote access without a Bridge. It charges a built-in battery in about two hours and has no keypad of its own. Home Assistant is not confirmed.
caveats: Matter needs a Thread border router; a Wi-Fi-only Matter hub will not work.
Not all Matter hubs support Remote Access via Thread, per Nuki's troubleshooting guide.
Not compatible with Nuki's Universal Cylinder.
The Keypad 2 NFC is a separate accessory.
